posts.name: The Chair
posts.caption:
Nobody types "laundry service" into a search bar. You scroll until something describes your room back to you.

So: the chair. It hasn't been a chair in a while. There is a hoodie on it doing structural work.

$100/month, flat. One 20 lb bag a week. Out Tuesday, back Thursday, folded.
Raleigh campuses. We start at Packapalooza, Saturday Aug 22.

Claim your spot: cleanyourdirtylaundry.com
